about: The spec of each page, each state and each workflow of abhyasa after the consolidation. A test (tests.md) builds the data of each state with temp_learning() and fakes, GETs the page, and checks must_show, must_not_show and the links to exits. Element names are data-part (a section) and data-act (an action) attributes; tests select [data-part=X] and [data-act=Y]. Labels are the on-screen words (ASD-STE100). The repo copy (tests/data/flows.json) is the source of truth; the design copy is history. An item is `kind:value`: part:X and act:Y check the first word of the value, label: checks the words (with {name} from the builder), one:X checks that exactly one [data-part=X] shows. Words after the first in part: and act: are a note. A state or a workflow with "pending": true has no code yet, and the test skips it.

data.about: The stored fields that decide each state. store: where the field lives. new: true when the field does not exist today.

walk.current.store: walk_state(j, by).current (derived; None when every step is done, skipped or known)

walk.here.store: lr.journey(jid)['here'] = {step, at}; written by GET of the idea page

walk.jobs.research.store: lr.journey(jid)['jobs']['research'] = {state: running|done|stopped|failed|closed, start, end, have, total, why, seen}
walk.jobs.research.replaces: research_start, research_end, gather_at, gather_end, research_seen, research_stopped, and Researcher.running() for the page

walk.steps[i].qid.store: lr.journey(jid).steps[i]['qid']; open when qid in tutor.open (runtime; the fixture opens it with GET /check)

course.jobs.store: lr.course(cid)['jobs'][kind] = {state, said, start, end, why}; kind level|plan|stage:<key>

course_state.store: course_state(lr, cid) (derived): here, next, blocking, finished

session.open.store: lr.session(sid): log is not None and not ended and (log or open)

continue.rule: last_place(lr) gives one place or None. A place is (walk, step) or (session). Candidates: (1) each walk that is not for a talk and has walk.current not None; a side walk counts as the step of its parent (walk.parent); its time is max(walk.here.at, the newest steps[i].read_at, walk.started). (2) each open session with no journey; its time is session.updated. The newest candidate wins. The step of a walk place is walk.here.step when that step is not done, else walk.current.
continue.show_when: place is not None AND the page is not the place's walk (/w/{jid} or /w/{jid}/{i} with the same jid, or the parent walk of a side walk) AND the page is not Home (Home shows the same place as its card) AND the page is not a review session.
continue.label: Continue: {walk title}  (a course walk: Continue: {course title})
continue.one_function: The top bar, the Home card and the course card call last_place. history.continue_link, history.continue_card and the course today_top card are replaced by it.
continue.cost: One query per page: the newest 10 walks by updated, and the newest open session. No progress() over all concepts.

course Pending as the only sign of a stage build
activity.transport: one SSE stream GET /events while a job runs (else no connection); the Mac app reads GET /jobs.json (replaces /walk/research.json)

demos.about: One idea: Explain and Show. Explain = the tutor talks and marks what you already see (the guide board). Show = a thing that you act on or watch (a rupaka spec). The rule says which one you get, where it shows, and which renderer draws it.

explain.what: board: steps with marks (circle, underline, arrow, label, point, sketch) and one spoken line each

predict.what: 2D rupaka spec, mode predict: you predict at each gate, then you see

explainer.what: 3D rupaka scene, mode learn: it builds one step at a time; no prediction

diagram.what: nodes and edges that show how parts of an idea link
diagram.renderer: today: board.js (placeDiagram). Proposed: a rupaka 'flow' block, mode learn, drawn in the Show slot

video.what: the idea's explainer video at a time
video.renderer: Show slot embed; board op video_at seeks it

notebook.moves_floor: only when Leela files a passed check

Code that runs in abhyasa: code goes to Leela.
demos.one_engine: show(lr, tutor, concept, said, where, kind=None) → ask row + job; one card ShowCard(ask) with three states (wait, ready, refused→2D). /demo/make and /demo/wait go; /demo/ask and /demo/asked stay.
demos.events: Each Show and each board writes one row with lr.put_ask (where, kind, said, slug). course rule 3 reads them: two or more on one idea and no right check since → check it now.
